environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; broad leaves with visible but soft ribbing; tactile, leathery surfaces with subtle specular highlights; rounded, appealing tips that fit the high-fidelity 3D animated film aesthetic.

visual_logic.composition: A mid-range shot focusing on a resilient cluster of broad, palm-like leaves growing out of a seasonal floodplain wash. The leaves catch intense sunlight, standing out against a vast geological backdrop.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, cracked dusty red mudflats with cross-bedded tan sandstone channels and scattered purple claystone fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; bright, direct midday sunlight with warm, natural highlights and soft-edged cinematic shadows that emphasize the 3D volume of the plants, with a slight hazy glow along the distant desert horizon.
